title: Hungarian Official Gazette Monitor
description: Monitor Magyar Közlöny (Hungarian Official Gazette), Cégközlöny (Company Gazette) and Pályázati Portál (Grant Portal) for new entries. Returns structured delta data — only new items since your last run.

sources.title: Sources to monitor
sources.description: Which official sources to scrape. Select one or more.

keywords.title: Keyword filter (optional)
keywords.description: Only return items whose title contains at least one of these keywords (case-insensitive, Hungarian accent-insensitive). Leave empty for all items.

cegkozlony_event_types.title: Cégközlöny – Event types to filter
cegkozlony_event_types.description: Filter Cégközlöny entries by event type. Leave empty for all types.

delta_mode.title: Delta mode (only new items)
delta_mode.description: If true, only return items not seen in previous runs (uses Apify Key-Value Store for deduplication). If false, return all items from the current feed.

max_items_per_source.title: Max items per source
max_items_per_source.description: Maximum number of items to return per source per run. 0 = unlimited.

date_from.title: Date from (optional, YYYY-MM-DD)
date_from.description: Only include items published on or after this date. Overrides delta mode for historical pulls.

output_language.title: Output field language
output_language.description: Language of output field names and event type labels.

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhook_url.description: If set, a POST request with the results will be sent to this URL at the end of each run.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests (recommended if some sources block data center IPs). Free plan may not include RESIDENTIAL proxies.

apify_proxy_groups.title: Apify Proxy groups
apify_proxy_groups.description: Proxy groups to use (e.g. RESIDENTIAL). If you don't have access, disable proxy.
